title: Your first trade for Tuesday, January 8
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of McDonald's .
Karen Finerman was a buyer of Target .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of GE .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Nordstrom .
